policy: Central scheduling (owner directive 2026-10-23; Rehtac Cortex 2.7.0 PL-15..PL-18): brain-orchestrator is the ONLY scheduling authority for automatic Brain execution. No other Brain scheduler may be ENABLED. brain-orchestrator may be ENABLED only while /control/executionControlV1 is ENABLED with an owner approvalRef, and only through tools/ops/resume-orchestrator.sh (never by a deployment). Deprecated per-Brain schedulers stay PAUSED.

brain-orchestrator.gate: the single scheduling authority; ENABLED only after owner authorization recorded in /control/executionControlV1 (state ENABLED + approvalRef) and passing preflight checks
brain-orchestrator.stop: gcloud scheduler jobs pause brain-orchestrator --location us-central1, and set the execution control PAUSED (tools/ops/execution_control.py pause)
brain-orchestrator.approvedAt: NOT APPROVED: paused by owner directive 2026-10-23; resumption needs a new owner approvalRef

wind-hourly.replacement: brain-orchestrator starts the wind-hourly job when Wind is due

lake-brain-ledger-daily.replacement: brain-orchestrator starts the lake-brain job when Lake is due (26 h)

pausedPipelinesNote: Brain input pipelines with their own (paused) schedulers. Their deploy scripts no longer create or update schedulers. Re-activation, if ever, goes through the orchestrator (PL-15), not their own cron.

firebase-schedule-sweepListingCoverOwner.owner: Sector app backend: Firebase scheduled function sweepListingCoverOwners (deployed by the Firebase CLI 2026-10-29), not a Brain
firebase-schedule-sweepListingCoverOwner.reason: Firebase creates one Cloud Scheduler job per scheduled function. This one publishes only to that function's own Pub/Sub topic (checked 2026-11-02: pubsubTarget, no HTTP target). It is not a Brain job, not in the execution manifest, and not started by the orchestrator. Its source is not in this repository and was not reviewed here; what it writes is the app's business.
firebase-schedule-sweepListingCoverOwner.approvalRef: Sector_Ops #46 P1 (owner approval 2026-11-02, recorded on #46 and #47)

nonBrainSchedulersNote: Live schedulers confirmed NOT Brain-related, so the audit does not report them UNMANAGED. Each entry pins its target; if the live job points anywhere else (another topic or any HTTP target) the audit reports DRIFT. A name may not be both here and in brainSchedulers or the execution manifest. Adding an entry needs an owner approvalRef.
